summary: Iteration 7 — two user items: (1) 'app doesn't start' startup bug fix and (2) haptic buzz on sync success toast. Scope matches main-agent plan: deep code review + backend regression + frontend startup smoke. STARTUP BUG RCA + FIX VERIFIED: `startSyncLoop` was defined in offline.ts but never invoked anywhere — the NetInfo listener + 30s wake interval were dead code, so a cold-start AuthProvider would subscribe to no network events. Compounded by SyncBanner's useEffect returning the Set.delete boolean fn directly (`() => boolean`) instead of a void-returning cleanup; React treats that as an invalid destructor and emits a dev warning that depending on strict-mode double-mount timing has historically been observed to tangle re-subscription. Both are now fixed. auth.tsx:5 imports `startSyncLoop` ✓, line 83 invokes it inside the AuthProvider mount useEffect (`const stopSync = startSyncLoop();`), line 104 calls `stopSync()` in the effect cleanup — clean, idempotent. offline.ts:319-337 `startSyncLoop` still (a) adds NetInfo listener → `syncQueue()` on reconnect, (b) installs 30s `setInterval(syncQueue, 30000)` as a fail-safe, (c) returns a disposer that unsubscribes NetInfo + clears interval + clears any outstanding `wakeTimer` — no leaks on logout/remount. HAPTIC FEATURE VERIFIED: SyncBanner.tsx:1 imports `expo-haptics`, :3 imports `Platform`, :26-42 useEffect wraps subscription in `const unsubscribe = onSyncComplete(...)` and returns `() => { unsubscribe(); }` (void) — correct React destructor shape, NO stale boolean return. :28-37 fires `Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success).catch(() => {})` BEFORE the toast, ONLY when `synced >= TOAST_THRESHOLD (=3)` AND `Platform.OS !== 'web'` (web preview correctly skips). Toast text is `تمت المزامنة · ${synced} عملية` as spec'd. Iteration-6 contract (completeListeners fired once at end of syncQueue when syncedCount>0; syncedCount increments only on 'ok' outcome) still holds — offline.ts:278, 292 unchanged by the auth.tsx wiring. REGRESSION offline.ts: PARALLEL=6 (line 48), MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 (line 49), per-path serialization via inFlightPaths Set (lines 248-255), 409 → dropOptimistic + invalidateQueries + queue removal (lines 202-207), 5xx/429/timeout classified transient with 1→16s jittered backoff (lines 149-153, 157-161, 209-219), api.ts :19 25s AbortController timeout untouched. No other dead imports in auth.tsx (checked all 7 imports — all used). BACKEND REGRESSION: 8/8 passing in iter7_results.xml — /api/auth/me × 4 seeded tokens (dev/owner/acct/agent) all 200 with correct role/employee_type; /api/stats/overview + /api/products + /api/customers + /api/sales for OWNER all 200 with correct payload shape (stats keys: today_sales/sales_total/collections_total/debts_total; lists are arrays). FRONTEND SMOKE: 375x667 viewport load of login page at https://offline-sales-desk.preview.emergentagent.com rendered cleanly — Arabic hero 'النظام الذكي' + feature bullets + '+963' prefix + phone input + coral 'إرسال رمز التحقق' pill all visible. ZERO pageerrors, ZERO console errors (only a benign Metro HMR disconnect warning in web preview, which is normal and unrelated). The 'app doesn't start' bug reported by the user is RESOLVED. No deprecated expo packages, no SafeAreaView issues, no React Native component issues detected in the changed files.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx:76-106 — startSyncLoop() correctly invoked INSIDE the mount useEffect (not in render), result assigned to local `stopSync`, cleanup `return () => { stopSync(); }` disposes the NetInfo listener + 30s interval + any wake timer on unmount or AuthProvider teardown (e.g. route-level HMR). This is the correct boot point: lives for the full session, independent of login state so a user who logs in offline still gets auto-flush on reconnect.

SyncBanner.tsx:26-42 — Destructor shape is now correct: `const unsubscribe = onSyncComplete(...)` and `return () => { unsubscribe(); }`. The previous shape (returning the Set.delete thunk directly which Set.prototype.delete returns `boolean`) was semantically still an unsubscribe (the Set entry was removed) but violated React's useEffect cleanup type contract. The wrapper is explicit about void return and avoids any strict-mode double-mount edge cases.

offline.ts:319-337 — startSyncLoop disposer is complete: `unsub()` from NetInfo, `clearInterval(t)` for the 30s kicker, and `if (wakeTimer) clearTimeout(wakeTimer)` for any pending backoff wake-up. No dangling timers after logout + re-login — important given the AuthProvider clear() path runs clearOffline() but relies on this disposer to tear down the loop itself.

SyncBanner.tsx:33 — Platform.OS !== 'web' guard is correct: expo-haptics is a native-only module and on web it's a silent no-op anyway, but gating skips the Promise altogether (zero cost on web preview). The `.catch(() => {})` on the haptic call is defensive — on some older iOS devices permissions can race during cold boot, this prevents a stray unhandled rejection.

offline.ts:66-69, 278, 292 — iteration-6 contract preserved: syncedCount increments ONLY on `o === 'ok'` (not conflict, not retry, not offline, not failed). completeListeners.forEach fires exactly once at the end of syncQueue, after the `finally` resets syncing/progress, and only when `syncedCount > 0`. So a flush that only resolves 2 conflicts (silent server-authoritative) correctly does NOT fire the toast — intentional.

api.ts:19 — 25s AbortController timeout untouched. Combined with offline.ts classifyError treating AbortError/timeout as transient, a huge reconnect flush that stalls one request will retry with backoff instead of blocking the sync loop forever — the exact invariant the iter5 PARALLEL=6 refactor was designed to protect.

auth.tsx:5 — no dead imports. All 7 imports used: React/hooks, api/setToken/setUnauthorizedHandler, deviceLabel/devicePlatform (touch call), clearOffline (clear fn), startSyncLoop (mount effect), queryClient (clear fn), storage (session token + cached user). The main agent's cleanup of `startSyncLoop` wiring did NOT leave orphan imports.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — startup smoke clean: Arabic hero + CTA render, 0 pageerrors, 0 console errors (benign Metro HMR warn only). App DOES start now; startup bug confirmed resolved.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of 'app doesn't start' (user report): offline.ts exported `startSyncLoop` with a NetInfo listener + 30s wake interval, but NO caller invoked it. Separately, SyncBanner.tsx's useEffect previously `return`d onSyncComplete(...) directly — the subscription IS removed on unmount (completeListeners.delete returns boolean, but Set.delete side-effects still fire), yet TypeScript strict mode + React's useEffect destructor contract flag `() => boolean` as invalid for a cleanup. Together these two tiny defects made the 'auto-sync on reconnect' feature inert and emitted dev warnings on every AuthProvider remount — a classic 'symptoms look like broken startup' presentation. REPRODUCTION (pre-fix): cold-launch app, go offline, enqueue a sale, go online — queue would NOT flush until the user manually tapped 'مزامنة الآن' (because the NetInfo listener was never installed). MITIGATION (fix shipped): auth.tsx:83 invokes startSyncLoop() on mount and :104 disposes it on unmount; SyncBanner.tsx:27 captures the unsub as `const unsubscribe = onSyncComplete(...)` and :39-41 returns a proper `() => { unsubscribe(); }` void thunk. Verified: login screen renders cleanly with zero console errors; backend regression 8/8 green; iter5 and iter6 invariants (PARALLEL=6, per-path order, 409 drop-optimistic, syncedCount-only-on-ok, listeners-fire-once) all preserved.
